name: zog-context-cancellable-schema-execution
instr:
Zog cannot safely cancel active parsing or validation. Build reusable cooperative cancellation at schema-safe boundaries, with deterministic progress, preserved completed work, and unchanged non-cancellable behavior.

Cancellation must be concurrency-safe and first-wins, distinguishing completion from cancellation without timing or scheduler ordering. Running callbacks finish normally. Publish completed transformations, but no later ones. Return one IssueCodeCancelled issue at the first untouched schema path, formatted with the selected formatter, execution context, and supplied CancelCause. Nested execution shares one CancellationReport without duplicating progress or terminal issues. Preserve completed primitive transformations, struct fields, and slice elements. Do not start, visit, count, or modify later work.

A field processor may cancel and finish normally; later fields and processors stay unstarted. Do not allocate pointers when cancellation precedes nested execution, or begin nested callbacks or visits. Preserve completed mutations once nested execution starts. Union cancellation is terminal: discard the active candidate clone, start no later candidate, and retain any previously committed result.

These are required in what you deliver:

- From github.com/Oudwins/zog: Cancellation, NewCancellation, Cancellation.Cancel, CancelCause, CancellationState, CancellationReport, WithCancellation, StringSchema.ParseCancellable, NumberSchema.ParseCancellable, StructSchema.Parse
